title: EduRiskX：基于F-Logic推理的神经符号框架用于早期学业风险预测
summary: EduRiskX是一个神经符号框架，结合时间Transformer预测器与F-Logic符号推理，用于在线教育中的早期学业风险预测。在OULAD数据集上，准确率0.900，F1分数0.894，平均早期检测周9.32，检测率94.30%，优于现有模型，并提供可解释的规则性解释。
summary_en: EduRiskX is a neuro-symbolic framework combining a temporal Transformer predictor with F-Logic symbolic reasoning for early academic risk prediction in online education. On OULAD, it achieves 0.900 accuracy, 0.894 F1, average early detection week 9.32, and 94.30% detection rate, outperforming baselines and providing interpretable rule-based explanations.
